management_attention.title: Resolve financial control-account discrepancies
management_attention.management_question: Which balances are reliable enough to manage the business from?
management_attention.rationale: 4 independently assessed reconciliation control(s) failed. Residuals are control exceptions, not assumed losses: UWB_AR_TO_TB: 982806.0, UWB_AP_TO_TB: -279000.0, UWB_INVENTORY_TO_SUPPORT: 120000.0, UWB_DEBT_TO_SUPPORT: -125000.0.
management_attention.next_step: Reconcile each failed control to source records, identify timing/classification differences and document resolution.
management_attention.limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

management_attention.title: Customer economics and concentration deserve review
management_attention.management_question: Which customer relationships create value and where is dependency material?
management_attention.rationale: 3 material signal(s) across CUS-01, CUS-02 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
management_attention.next_step: Review contribution, concentration and commercial context for the customers driving the evidence.
management_attention.limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

management_attention.title: Supplier spend concentration requires commercial review
management_attention.management_question: Where does supplier concentration create dependency or negotiating exposure?
management_attention.rationale: 6 material signal(s) across SUP-01, SUP-03 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
management_attention.next_step: Review critical suppliers, alternatives, contract terms and operational substitutability before assigning risk value.
management_attention.limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

management_attention.title: Operational capacity appears constrained
management_attention.management_question: Which work centres are genuinely capacity constrained and what is driving the load?
management_attention.rationale: 1 material signal(s) across PEO-04 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
management_attention.next_step: Validate hours and constraints, then test overtime, bottlenecks, scheduling, mix and investment options before monetising.
management_attention.limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

management_attention.title: Working capital requires focused investigation
management_attention.management_question: What portion of working capital is genuinely addressable without harming operations?
management_attention.rationale: 2 material signal(s) across WC-06, WC-07 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
management_attention.next_step: Investigate the underlying balances, causes, timing and operational guardrails before estimating cash release.
management_attention.limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

items.recommended_action: Reconcile failed control balances to source records and resolve timing, classification and posting differences.
items.evidence_required: Underlying ledger detail, control-account roll-forward and documented reconciling items.
items.limitation: Reconciliation residuals are control exceptions, not losses, savings or cash opportunities.

items.recommended_action: Review concentrated and low-contribution customer relationships; identify price, mix, service or retention interventions only where mechanism evidence exists.
items.evidence_required: Customer/product mix, price history, direct cost and where available cost-to-serve evidence.
items.limitation: No monetary opportunity is supported from this management priority without mechanism, addressability and recovery-envelope evidence.

items.recommended_action: Review concentrated suppliers for criticality, alternatives, terms and negotiation opportunities.
items.evidence_required: Contracts, item-level purchases/prices, alternative-source evidence and operational criticality.
items.limitation: No monetary opportunity is supported from this management priority without mechanism, addressability and recovery-envelope evidence.

items.recommended_action: Validate bottleneck load and test scheduling, overtime, mix, process and investment alternatives before monetising.
items.evidence_required: Validated practical capacity, productive hours, overtime, throughput, scrap/downtime and contribution at constraint.
items.limitation: Capacity released or data corrected is not a saving unless an evidenced economic use or avoided cost is demonstrated.

items.recommended_action: Identify genuinely addressable receivables, payables and inventory actions subject to operational guardrails.
items.evidence_required: Invoice/aging detail, disputes/credits, supplier terms, stock aging/service-level evidence and cash timing.
items.limitation: No monetary opportunity is supported from this management priority without mechanism, addressability and recovery-envelope evidence.
